scope: Named boundary fields and data-dependent byte selection; correctness and source lifetimes, not a performance comparison
limitations: Declared boundary layouts are not a universal storage schema or application object model
Only u32le, fixed bytes, and a final variable byte field; no general arithmetic or schema version negotiation
Dynamic ranges operate on PUT input; GET numeric-dependent ranges are rejected
One storage effect per handler, no read-modify-write, branches or feedback loops
Program always reserves room for eight dynamic range steps, including programs that use none
Source receive allocation remains fully retained/charged even when a small selection is returned
Server byte fields do not validate UTF-8; the example Python client preserves code-point boundaries
Logical payload bounds exclude mapping pages, page cache, disk, OS sockets and client allocations
Synchronous storage can delay other connections and timeout enforcement
Linux AArch64 only; macOS, real power loss, and large-service performance not tested
